# اُنْتُهِبَا (untuhibā) /un.tu.hi.baː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِنْتَهَبَ (intahaba)
# اِنْتَهِبَا (intahibā) /in.ta.hi.baː/: second-person dual imperative of اِنْتَهَبَ (intahaba)
